scope: Cancellation during fingerprint-cache header, record, checksum and EOF reads
before_fix: Bounded repeated-interruption reproducer failed at byte zero with Io(Other): read_exact retried Interrupted without observing cancellation.
fix: Internal exact-read loop checks cancellation before each short read and retry. Preserves UnexpectedEof on truncation, Io for other errors, and checksummed format.
limits: Does not interrupt a Read call that itself blocks; custom readers require their own timeouts.
Finite synthetic stream control, not every filesystem/platform or universal coverage proof.
